text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having safely made it through the Hanshin JF,
one day, while continuing training towards the Classic class...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
2000m,
that's one lap, correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the Hanshin JF, Mejiro Ramonu demonstrated her tremendous capability at the mile distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So today, I was checking how she'd perform
at the medium distances she'll be running in the future."
choice_data_list: (Still, there was no real need to check, was there?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Displaying her mile-honed speed and explosive acceleration,
Mejiro Ramonu firmly maintained her stamina to the very end,
running out the full 2,000 meters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How about it?
choice_data_list: It's absolutely flawless, no problem at all!
It's absolutely flawless, no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I suppose so.
Now, let's continue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Once the new year arrives, there won't even be time to catch our breath.
The 1,600 meters of the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "The 2400m of the Oaks, and the 2000m of the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Because in everything,
I will show a flawless run—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training was over... Alone, I pondered
which races I wanted Mejiro Ramonu to run
from here on out.
choice_data_list: (Mile or middle distance—which one will let me shine brighter...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's the mile, besides the target Oka Sho,
there's also the Yasuda Kinen, Mile Championship,
Victoria Mile, and so on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's middle distance, in addition to our target races,
the Oaks and the Shuka Sho,
there's also the Takarazuka Kinen and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Examples include the Japan Cup, Osaka Hai, and Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of them are magnificent, premier GⅠ races...
If she, already so remarkably talented, concentrates on a single path, the result will be—
choice_data_list: It's going to be absolutely amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Keep challenging mile races to perfect your technique... or win medium-distance races and walk a steady path to glory—
choice_data_list: I want to master technique in mile races!
I want to pursue the glorious path of medium distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I want to see Mejiro Ramonu at the absolute peak of the mile.
First, I must focus on the Triple Tiara, but... I'll keep that in mind when planning future races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――I want to see Mejiro Ramonu win at middle distance.
First, we focus on the Triple Tiara, but...
let's use this to help decide future races.
